items.text: oṁ asya śrī rudrādhyāya praśna mahāmantrasya ।

translation.en: This chapter is the Rudra section of a great mantra.

text.en: right palm touching the top of the head

items.text: aghora  ṛṣiḥ ।

translation.en: The seer is Aghora,

text.en: right palm in front of the mouth

items.text: anuṣṭup chandaḥ ।

translation.en: The metre is anuṣṭup,

items.text:
saṅkarṣaṇa mūrti svarūpo yo'sāvā-dityaḥ
paramapuruṣas sa  eṣa rudro devatā ।

translation.en: The deity is the Supreme Being who is the god in the form of Saṅkarṣaṇa, he is this Rudra,

text.en: touch the lowermost rib on the right side

items.text: namaś śivāyeti bījamˎ ।

translation.en: The seed mantra is 'namaḥ śivāya' (salutations to Śiva),

text.en: touch the lowermost rib on the left side

items.text: śivatarāyeti śaktiḥ ।

translation.en: The power is 'śivatarāya' (to the most auspicious one, also a 5-syllable mantra),

text.en: touch the middle above the navel, underneath the sternum

items.text: mahādevāyeti kīlakamˎ ।

translation.en: The bolt (kīlaka) is 'mahādevāya' (to Mahādeva),

items.text:
śrī sāmba sadāśiva (parameśvara)  
prasāda siddhyarthe (śrī rudra) jape viniyogaḥ ॥

translation.en: The dedication is for the attainment of the grace of Śrī Sāmba Sadāśiva (the Supreme Lord who is attended by Ambā ) through the recitation (of Śrī Rudra).

text.en: Purification of the hands, artificial svaras.

items.text: agnihotrā-tmane  aṅguṣṭhābhyān namaḥ ।

translation.en: To the essence of the Agnihotra ritual, salutations with both thumbs.

items.text: darśapūrṇa māsā-tmane tarjanībhyān namaḥ ।

translation.en: To the essence of the new and full moon ritual, salutations with both index fingers.

items.text: cāturmāsyā-tmane madhyamābhyān namaḥ ।

translation.en: To the essence of the 4-month season beginning ritual, salutations with both middle fingers.

items.text: nirūḍha paśu bandhā-tmane  anāmikābhyān namaḥ ।

translation.en: To the essence of the sacrificial animal binding ritual, salutations with both ring fingers.

items.text: jyotiṣṭomā-tmane kaniṣṭhikābhyān namaḥ ।

translation.en: To the essence of the Soma ritual, both little fingers.

text.en: with both palms and the backs of the hands

items.text: sarva kratvā-tmane karatala karapṛṣṭhābhyān namaḥ ॥

translation.en: To the essence of all the rituals, salutations with both palms and the backs of the hands.

text.en: Purification of the body, artificial svaras.

items.text: agnihotrā-tmane hṛdayāya namaḥ ।

translation.en: The essence of the Agnihotra ritual to the heart, salutation,

text.en: to the top of the head, the vertex

items.text: darśapūrṇa māsā-tmane śirase svāhā ।

translation.en: The essence of the new moon and full moon rituals to the head, svāhā (hail!),

text.en: to the back of the head, the nape

items.text: cāturmāsyā-tmane śikhāyai vaṣaṭˎ ।

translation.en: The essence of the 4-month season beginning ritual to to the tuft, vaṣaṭ (hail!),

items.text: nirūḍha paśu bandhā-tmane kavacāya huṁ ।

translation.en: The essence of the sacrificial animal binding ritual to the armour, the bija huṁ,

items.text: jyotiṣṭomā-tmane netra trayāya vauṣaṭˎ ।

translation.en: The essence of the Soma ritual to the three eyes, vauṣaṭ (hail!),

items.text: sarva kratvā-tmane  astrāya phaṭˎ ।

translation.en: The essence of all the rituals to the weapon, phaṭ,

items.text: bhūr bhuvas svarom iti digbandhaḥ ॥

translation.en: The earth, atmosphere, heavens, and beyond, this is the sealing of the directions.

text.en: Śārdūlavikrīḍitaṁ chandaḥ, 19 syllables per pāda, yatiḥ after the 12th, and 19th.

items.text:
oṁ  āpātāla nabhas sthalā-nta bhuvana   
 brahmāṇḍamā-visphurat  
jyotis sphāṭika liṅga mauli vilasat   
 pūrṇendu vāntā-mṛtaiḥ । 
astokā-plutame-kamī-śama-niśaṁ   
 rudrā-nuvākāñ japan   
dhyāyedī-psita siddhaye dhruvapadaṁ   
 vipro'bhiṣiñcec chivamˎ॥

translation.en: Oṁ, from the lower depths to the sky, to the ends of the earth, throughout all worlds, and the vast shimmering universe. The radiant crystal Śiva-liṅga, gleaming at the crown, exuding the nectar of the full moon. Of aboundingly sanctified One Lord, always reciting the hymns of Rudra, one should meditate for the attainment of the desired high status, and may the wise one sprinkle Śiva (perform Abhiṣekam). DV

text.en: Sragdharā chandaḥ, 21 syllables per pāda, yatiḥ at 7th, 14th, and 21th.

brahmāṇḍa vyāpta dehā   
 -bhasita himarucā  bhāsamānā bhujaṅgaiḥ   
kaṇṭhekālāḥ kapardāḥ   
 kalita śaśikalāś  caṇḍa kodaṇḍa hastāḥ । 
tryakṣā rudrākṣa mālāḥ   
 prakaṭita vibhavāś  śāmbhavā mūrti bhedāḥ   
rudrāś śrī rudra sūkta   
 prakaṭita vibhavā  naḥ prayacchantu saukhyamˎ॥

translation.en: Pervades the whole Universe, the body resembling the Moon (himarucā) shining, with serpents, dark-throated, with matted locks, furnished with the crescent moon, and fierce bow in His hands. The three-eyed ones, adorned with Rudrākṣa garlands, manifesting powers and taking various forms of Śambhu, The Rudras that the Śrī Rudra hymn, reveals their powers, may they grant us happiness. DV

text.en: roll the index fingers over the thumbs

text.en: roll the thumbs over the index fingers

items.text: yaṁ  vāyvā-tmane  dhūpaṅ kalpayāmi ।

translation.en: yaṁ, to the one whose essence is Air (Vāyu), I mentally offer incense.

items.text: raṁ  agnyā-tmane  dīpaṅ kalpayāmi ।

items.text: vaṁ  amṛtā-tmane  amṛtaṅ kalpayāmi ।

translation.en: vaṁ, to the one whose essence is Amṛta (immortality), I mentally offer nectar.

items.text: saṁ  sarvā-tmane  samasto-pacārān samarpayāmi ॥

translation.en: saṁ, to the one whose essence is everything, I offer all services in person.

items.text:
śañ ca me mayaśca me
priyañ ca me'nukāmaśca me
kāmaśca me saumanasaśca me

translation.en: (Having received with splendours and strengths: ) My peace and joy, love and desire, affection and kindness,

items.text:
bhadrañ ca me śreyaśca me
vasyaśca me yaśaśca me
bhagaśca me draviṇañ ca me

translation.en: My well-being and improvement, more wealth and fame, prosperity and riches,

yantā ca me dhartā ca me
kṣemaśca me dhṛtiśca me
viśvañ ca me mahaśca me
saṁvicca me jñātrañ ca me

translation.en: My protector and sustainer, safety and courage, the universe and greatness, consciousness and understanding,

items.text:
sūśca me prasūśca me
sīrañ ca me layaśca ma
ṛtañ ca me'mṛtañ ca me
'yakṣmañ ca me'nāmayacca me

translation.en: My parent and offspring, plough and hoe, truth and immortality, health and painlessness,

accented: su̱gaṁ ca̍ me̱ śaya̍naṁ ca me
sū̱ṣā ca̍ me su̱dina̍ṁ ca me ||3||
lines: sugaṁ ca me śayanaṁ ca me
sūṣā ca me sudinaṁ ca me ||3||

jīvātuśca me dīrghāyutvañ ca me
'namitrañ ca me'bhayañ ca me
sugañ ca me śayanañ ca me
sūṣā ca me sudinañ ca me ॥3॥

translation.en: My vitality and long life, having no enemies and fearlessness, comfort and good sleep, an auspicious dawn and good day.

items.text: ॥ oṁ śāntiś śāntiś śāntiḥ ॥

translation.en: May the three kinds of pain be averted!

items.text:
। anukramaṇi ।  
kṛṣṇayajurvedīya taittirīya saṁhitā caturthaṁ vaiśvadevaṅ kāṇḍam  
pañcamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ॥

translation.en: The 5th chapter of the 4th Vaiśvadeva book of the Taittirīya Saṁhitā belonging to the Kṛṣṇa Yajurveda.

sections.title: Anukramaṇi

items.text: ॥oṁ namo bhagavate rudrāya ॥

translation.en: Salutations to the blessed Rudra.

items.text:
oṁ  namas te rudra manyava  uto-ta  iṣave namaḥ । 
namas te  astu dhanvane bāhubhyāmu-ta te namaḥ ॥1.1॥

translation.en: Salutation to the Rudra’s furies, and to your beloved arrow (action) salutation. Salutation to your bow (aim) and salutation to your both arms.

items.text:
yā ta  iṣuś śivatamā śivam babhūva te dhanuḥ । 
śivā śaravyā yā tava tayā no rudra mṛḍaya ॥1.2॥

translation.en: That your arrow which is the most auspicious and auspicious is your bow. And with that auspicious quiver of yours o Rudra you make us happy.

items.text:
yā te rudra śivā tanūra-ghorā'pāpakāśinī । 
tayā nas tanuvā śantamayā giriśantā-bhi cākaśīhi ॥1.3॥

translation.en: O Rudra, your body that is auspicious is not terrifying and not evil looking. With that most peaceful body of yours become visible to us, o Lord of the mountains.

items.text:
yāmi-ṣuṅ giriśanta haste bibharṣya-stave ।  
śivāṅ giritra tāṅ kuru mā him̐sīḥ puruṣañ jagatˎ॥1.4॥

translation.en: O Dweller in the mountains, the arrow you bear in your hand for shooting, o auspicious protector of the mountain, please make it not intend to harm people or herds.

items.text:
śivena vacasā tvā giriśā-cchāvadāmasi । 
yathā nas sarvami-jjagada-yakṣmam̐ sumanā  asatˎ॥1.5॥

translation.en: We salute you with auspicious words, o mountain lord, so that for us the whole world may indeed be healthy and friendly.

text.en: in “jambhayant sarvāśca” the letter “t” is āgama, inserted letter, called abhinidhānaḥ (T. Pr. XIV. 9.)

items.text:
adhyavocada-dhivaktā prathamo daivyo bhiṣakˎ। 
ahīm̐śca sarvāñ jambhayant sarvāśca yātu dhānyaḥ ॥1.6॥

translation.en: The protector and the first divine healer declared, that all snakes and all evil spirits are crushed.

items.text:
asau yas tāmro  aruṇa  uta babhrus sumaṅgalaḥ । 
ye ce-mām̐ rudrā  abhito dikṣu  
śritās sahasraśo'vaiṣām̐ heḍa  īmahe ॥1.7॥

translation.en: That one who is copper-red, reddish as the dawn, that is brown, and auspicious, All these Rudras who are situated around in the thousands directions, we beg protection from their wrath.

items.text:
asau yo'vasarpati nīla grīvo vilohitaḥ । 
utai-naṅ gopā  adṛśanna-dṛśannu-dahāryaḥ । 
utai-naṁ viśvā bhūtāni sa dṛṣṭo mṛḍayāti naḥ ॥1.8॥

translation.en: That blue-throated and very red one who sneaks, the cowherds saw and the water-bearers saw Him, and Him having been seen by all the creatures grants us happiness.

items.text:
namo  astu nīla grīvāya sahasrā-kṣāya mīḍhuṣe । 
atho ye  asya satvāno'han tebhyo'karan namaḥ ॥1.9॥

translation.en: Salutation to the blue-throated thousand-eyed bountiful one, and also to all those beings of his, to them I offered my salutations.

items.text:
pramuñca dhanvanas tvamu-bhayorā-rtniyor jyāmˎ। 
yāś ca te hasta  iṣavaḥ parā tā bhagavo vapa ॥1.10॥

translation.en: You loosen the bow string from both of the tips, and those arrows in your hand, o blessed one, may you throw them away.

items.text:
avatatya dhanus tvam̐ sahasrā-kṣa śate-ṣudhe । 
niśīrya śalyānām mukhā śivo nas sumanā bhava ॥1.11॥

translation.en: Having unstrung the bow, you are a thousand-eyed owner of a hundred quivers, and having broken off the arrow tips, be auspicious and benevolent to us!

items.text:
vijyan dhanuḥ kapardino viśalyo bāṇavām̐  uta । 
aneśanna-sye-ṣava  ābhura-sya niṣaṅgathiḥ ॥1.12॥

translation.en: Unstrung is the bow of him with the matted hair, and pointless is the arrow, his arrows are lost, empty is his quiver.

items.text:
yā te hetir mīḍhuṣṭama haste babhūva te dhanuḥ । 
tayā'smānˎ viśvatas tvama-yakṣmayā paribbhuja ॥1.13॥

translation.en: O most generous one the arrow that was in your hand, and your bow, You are that one with freedom from disease, please protect us from all sides!

items.text:
namas te  astvā-yudhāyā-nātatāya dhṛṣṇave । 
ubhābhyāmu-ta te namo bāhubhyān tava dhanvane ॥1.14॥

translation.en: May there be salutations to you, the courageous one and to the unstrung weapon, and salutation to both of your hands and to your bow.

items.text:
pari te dhanvano hetira-smānˎ vṛṇaktu viśvataḥ । 
atho ya  iṣudhis tavā-re  asman nidhehi tamˎ॥1.15॥

translation.en: May the arrow from your bow avoid us from all sides, Likewise that quiver of yours, please place it there far from us.

items.text: ॥śambhave namaḥ ॥

translation.en: Salutations to Śambhu.

items.text:
namas te  astu bhagavan  viśveśvarāya mahādevāya  
tryambakāya tripurāntakāya trikāgnikālāya  
kālāgni rudrāya nīlakaṇṭhāya mṛtyuñjayāya  
sarveśvarāya sadāśivāya (śaṅkarāya)  
śrīman mahādevāya namaḥ ॥

translation.en: Salutations to the revered Lord of the Universe, to the great God, to the three-eyed one, annihilator of Tripura, to the one who embodies the three fires and time, to Rudra as the fire of time, to the blue-throated one, to the conqueror of death, to the Lord of all, to the eternally auspicious one (to Śaṅkara, the giver of peace), to to the glorious and great god, salutations!

translation.en: Salutation to the golden-armed leader of the armies, and to the lord of the directions salutation! Salutation to the trees, and to the lord of the fair-haired animals salutation! Salutation to the ruddy-coloured radiant lord of the paths salutation! Salutation to the brown one, to the piercer, to the lord of the food salutation!

namo harikeśāyo-pavītine puṣṭānām pataye namo
namo bhavasya hetyai jagatām pataye namo
namo rudrāyā-tatāvine kṣetrāṇām pataye namo
namas sūtāyā-hantyāya vanānām pataye namo

translation.en: Salutation to the fair haired wearer of the sacred thread, to the lord of the nourished beings salutation! Salutation to the weapon of Bhava, to the lord of all that is alive salutation! Salutation to Rudra the wielder of the bow, to the lord of the land salutation! Salutation to the indestructible charioteer, to the lord of the forests salutation!

Salutation to the one with a turban that moves in mountain, to the lord of those who pluck hair, salutation!

Salutation to the horses, and to you lords of the horses salutation!

translation.en: Salutation to Bhava, the auspicious one, and to Rudra, the fierce one. Salutation to Śarva, who kills people with arrows, and to Paśupati, the lord of animals. translation.en: Salutation to the lord of the mountains, and to the one pervading by rays. Salutation to the most generous one, and to the one armed with arrow. Salutation to the short one, and to the dwarf. Salutation to the large one, and to the greater one. Salutation to the growing one, and to the one who grows or greatly.

translation.en: Salutation to the best one, and to the first one. Salutation to the swift one, and to the agile one. Salutation to the speedy one, and to the quick one. Salutation to the one moving like a wave, and to the one roaring as rapids. Salutation to the one flowing in the streams, and to the one of the island.

translation.en: Salutation to the one who belongs to Yama and to the one at peace. Salutations to the one of the fertile lands and to the one on the grains threshing floor. Salutations to the praiseworthy one and to the one whose name belongs in a verse. Salutations to the one in the woods and to the one in shrubs or dry grass. Salutations to the one who is sounding and to the one who echoes.

Salutations to the one renowned or famous and to the one leading renowned armies.

namo'paguramāṇāya cā-bhighnate ca
nama  ākkhidate ca prakkhidate ca

translation.en: Salutations to the one being in inaccessible places and to the one in the grass. Salutations to the one being in ponds or lakes and to the one in irrigation channel. Salutations to the one in the leaves and to the one in the falling leaves. Salutations to the retreating and the one who kills. Salutations to the one who takes and the one who throws away.

items.text:
namo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānām̐ hṛdayebhyo
namo vikṣīṇakebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo
nama  ānirhatebhyo nama  āmīvatkebhyaḥ ॥9॥

translation.en: Salutations to you beaming the hearts of the Devas. Salutations to the destroyers, salutations to the seekers. Salutations to the indestructible ones, salutations to those who are attacking.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.5 — the fifth prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Navamo'nuvākaḥ

items.text:
drāpe  andhasaspate daridran nīlalohita । 
eṣām puruṣāṇāme-ṣām paśūnām  
mā bher mā'ro mo  eṣāṅ kiñcanā mamatˎ॥10.1॥

translation.en: O Hastener, lord of soma, unattached blue-red (purple) one, don’t let these people and cattle fear, nor they die swiftly, but at some other time.

items.text:
yā te rudra śivā tanūś śivā viśvā-ha bheṣajī । 
śivā rudrasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase ॥10.2॥

translation.en: Your benevolent form is said to be auspicious for healing the world. With that Rudra’s auspicious remedy, grant us bliss for life.

items.text:
imām̐ rudrāya tavase kapardine  
kṣayad vīrāya prabharāmahe matimˎ। 
yathā naś śama sad dvipade catuṣpade  
viśvam puṣṭaṅ grāme  asminna-nāturamˎ॥10.3॥

translation.en: To Rudra, the powerful one with matted hair, who destroys enemy heroes, we offer devotion. May our peace be eternal, so every human and animal in this village is nourished and free from disease.

items.text:
mṛḍā no rudro-ta no mayas kṛdhi  
kṣayad vīrāya namasā vidhema te । 
yacchañ ca yoś ca manurā-yaje pitā  
tada-śyāma tava rudra praṇītau ॥10.4॥

translation.en: Be gracious to us, O Rudra, and bring us joy. To the destroyer of heroes, we offer our reverence. The peace and health won by our father Manu, may we obtain these under your able guidance, O Rudra.

items.text:
mā no mahāntamu-ta mā no  arbhakam  
mā na  ukṣantamu-ta mā na  ukṣitamˎ। 
mā no vadhīḥ pitaram mo-ta mātaram priyā  
mā nas tanuvo rudra rīriṣaḥ ॥10.5॥

translation.en: Do not harm our elders, our children, those who are growing, and do not harm those who have grown. Do not kill our beloved father or mother, nor harm their bodies, O Rudra.

items.text:
mā nas toke tanaye mā na  āyuṣi  
mā no goṣu mā no  aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ । 
vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito'vadhīrhaviṣmanto  
namasā vidhema te ॥10.6॥

translation.en: Do not harm our children, our descendants, our lifespan, our cows, or our horses. O Rudra, do not kill in anger our brave men who offer sacrifices. We worship you with reverence.

items.text:
ārāt te goghna  uta pūruṣaghne kṣayad vīrāya  
sumnama-sme te  astu । 
rakṣā ca no  adhi ca deva brūhya-dhā  
ca naś śarma yaccha dvibarhāḥ ॥10.7॥

translation.en: May your cow-killing and man-slaying be far away, O destroyer of heroes. Let your favor be with us. Protect us and speak over us, O god. Then grant us happiness, O two-fold exalted one.

items.text:
stuhi śrutaṅ gartasadaṁ yuvānam mṛgan na  
bhīmamu-pahatnumu-gramˎ। 
mṛḍā jaritre rudra stavāno  anyan te   
asman nivapantu senāḥ ॥10.8॥

translation.en: Praise the renowned, chariot-seated, young one, fierce like a fearsome beast, who strikes down. Be gracious to the worshipper, O Rudra, who is praising you. Let the armies of others be destroyed for us.

items.text:
pari ṇo rudrasya hetir vṛṇaktu  
pari tveṣasya durmatira-ghāyoḥ । 
ava sthirā maghavadbhyas tanuṣva  
mīḍhvas tokāya tanayāya mṛḍaya ॥10.9॥

translation.en: May the weapon of Rudra be warded off from us, may the evil intention of the fierce one be away from harm. Protect the firm and generous ones, extend your bounty. Be gracious to our children and descendants.

items.text:
mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama śivo nas sumanā bhava । 
parame vṛkṣa  āyudhan nidhāya  
kṛttiṁ vasāna  ācara pinākam bibhradā-gahi ॥10.10॥

translation.en: O most bountiful and most auspicious one, be benevolent to us. Having placed your weapon on the highest tree, advance wearing the skin, come bearing the Pinaka bow.

items.text:
vikirida vilohita namas te  astu bhagavaḥ । 
yās te sahasram̐ hetayo'nyama-sman nivapantu tāḥ ॥10.11॥

translation.en: Salutations to you, o caster of arrows, o fiery one, o Lord. May your thousand weapons destroy others, not us.

items.text:
sahasrāṇi sahasradhā bāhuvos tava hetayaḥ । 
tāsāmī-śāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi ॥10.12॥

translation.en: Thousands upon thousands are the weapons in your arms. O blessed Lord, make the faces of those (weapons) turned away.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.5 — the fifth prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Daśamo'nuvākaḥ

items.text:
sahasrāṇi sahasraśo ye rudrā  adhi bhūmyāmˎ। 
teṣām̐ sahasra yojane'vadhanvāni tanmasi ॥11.1॥

translation.en: Thousands upon thousands of Rudras who are on the earth, Their bows we unstring thousand yojanas away.

items.text: asmin mahatya-rṇave'ntarikṣe bhavā  adhi ॥11.2॥

translation.en: Also of the Rudras in this great ocean, and in the atmosphere,

accented: nīla̍ grīvāḥ śiti̱ kaṇṭhā̎ḥ śa̱rvā a̱dhaḥ: kṣa̍mā ca̱rāḥ ||11.3||
lines: nīla grīvāḥ śiti kaṇṭhāḥ śarvā adhaḥ: kṣamā carāḥ ||11.3||

items.text: nīla grīvāś śiti kaṇṭhāś śarvā  adhaḥ: kṣamā carāḥ ॥11.3॥

translation.en: (also) of blue-necked, white-throated Rudras, who move below the earth,

accented: nīla̍ grīvāḥ śiti̱ kaṇṭhā̱ divaṁ̍ ru̱drā upa̍śritāḥ ||11.4||
lines: nīla grīvāḥ śiti kaṇṭhā divaṁ rudrā upaśritāḥ ||11.4||

items.text: nīla grīvāś śiti kaṇṭhā divam̐ rudrā  upaśritāḥ ॥11.4॥

translation.en: (also) of the blue-necked, white-throated Rudras, who have taken refuge in heaven,

accented: ye vṛ̱kṣeṣu̍ sa̱spiñja̍rā̱ nīla̍ grīvā̱ vilo̍hitāḥ ||11.5||
lines: ye vṛkṣeṣu saspiñjarā nīla grīvā vilohitāḥ ||11.5||

items.text: ye vṛkṣeṣu saspiñjarā nīla grīvā vilohitāḥ ॥11.5॥

translation.en: (also) those in the trees who are yellowish like young grass, blue-necked, and reddish,

items.text: ye bhūtānāma-dhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ ॥11.6॥

translation.en: (also) those who are the uncrowned lords of beings, with matted hair,

accented: ye anne̍ṣu vi̱vidhya̍nti̱ pātre̍ṣu̱ piba̍to̱ janān̍ˎ||11.7||
lines: ye anneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janānˎ||11.7||

items.text: ye  anneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janānˎ ॥11.7॥

translation.en: (also) those in the food and drinking cups who are piercing people,

items.text: ye pathām pathirakṣaya  ailabṛdā yavyudhaḥ ॥11.8॥

translation.en: (also) those who are the protectors of the paths of the givers of food, and of the warriors eager to fight,

items.text: ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāvanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ ॥11.9॥

translation.en: (also) the spear bearers and sword bearers who move about the sacred places,

items.text:
ya  etāvantaś ca bhūyām̐saś ca diśo rudrā vitasthire । 
teṣām̐ sahasra yojane'vadhanvāni tanmasi ॥11.10॥

translation.en: (also) the Rudras who have spread in many many directions, their bows we unstring thousand yojanas away.

accented: namo̍ ru̱drebhyo̱ ye pṛ̍thi̱vyāṁ ye̎'ntari̍kṣe̱ ye di̱vi
daśa̱ prācī̱r daśa̍ dakṣi̱ṇā daśa̍ pra̱tīcī̱r daśo-dī̍cī̱r daśo̱-rdhvās
tebhyo̱ nama̱s te no̍ mṛḍayantu̱ te
yaṁ dvi̱ṣmo yaś ca̍ no̱ dveṣṭi̱
lines: namo rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāṁ ye'ntarikṣe ye divi
daśa prācīr daśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīr daśo-dīcīr daśo-rdhvās
tebhyo namas te no mṛḍayantu te
yaṁ dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi

items.text:
namo rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāṁ ye'ntarikṣe ye divi
yeṣāma-nnaṁ vāto varṣami-ṣavas tebhyo
daśa prācīr daśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīr daśo-dīcīr daśo-rdhvās
tebhyo namas te no mṛḍayantu te
yan dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi
taṁ vo jambhe dadhāmi ॥11.11॥

translation.en: Salutation to the Rudras who are on the earth, in the atmosphere, and in heaven, whose food, and wind, and rain are the arrows, ten in the east, ten in the south, ten in the west, ten in the north, ten upward, salutation to them. May they be gracious to us. Those whom we hate and who hate us, I place them in your jaws.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.5 — the fifth prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Ekādaśo'nuvākaḥ

items.text:
tryambakaṁ yajāmahe sugandhim puṣṭi vardhanamˎ। 
urvā-rukami-va bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya mā'mṛtātˎ॥

translation.en: We worship the three-eyed one, who is fragrant and is nourishing all growth. Like breaking free from binding of a great affliction, may I be freed from death, but not from immortality!

accented: yo ru̱dro a̱gnau yo a̱psu ya oṣa̍dhīṣu̱
yo ru̱dro viśvā̱ bhuva̍nā vi̱veśa̱ tasmai̍ ru̱drāya̱ namo̍ astu ||
lines: yo rudro agnau yo apsu ya oṣadhīṣu
yo rudro viśvā bhuvanā viveśa tasmai rudrāya namo astu ||

items.text:
yo rudro  agnau yo  apsu ya  oṣadhīṣu
yo rudro viśvā bhuvanā viveśa tasmai rudrāya namo  astu ॥

translation.en: Rudra who is in the fire, who is in the waters, who is in the plants, who has entered all the worlds, to that Rudra let us salute.

items.text:
tamu ṣṭuhi yas sviṣus sudhanvā yo viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya । 
yakṣvāmahe saumanasāya rudran namobhir devama-suran duvasya ॥

translation.en: Praise him indeed, the archer with a good bow, who rules over all cures. For well-being we worship with reverence the god Rudra, the divine spirit of blessings giving.

items.text:
ayam me hasto bhagavāna-yam me bhagavattaraḥ । 
ayam me viśva bheṣajo'yam̐ śivābhimarśanaḥ ॥

translation.en: This hand of mine is divine, this hand of mine is more divine. This hand of mine is the universal healer, this hand of mine has an auspicious touch.

items.text:
ye te sahasrama-yutam pāśā mṛtyo martyāya hantave । 
tānˎ yajñasya māyayā sarvāna-va yajāmahe ॥

translation.en: Those myriads of nooses of yours, O Death, for killing mortals, by the power of the yajña we worship all of them for protection.

items.text: mṛtyave svāhā mṛtyave svāhā ॥

translation.en: To Death, svāhā! To Death, svāhā!

items.text:
oṁ  namo bhagavate rudrāya viṣṇave mṛtyurme pāhi । 
prāṇānāṅ granthira-si rudro mā viśāntakaḥ । 
tenā-nnenā-pyāyasva ॥

translation.en: Oṁ, salutations to the blessed one, to Rudra and to Viṣṇu. Protect me from death! You are the knot of the life forces, O Rudra, the destroyer of death, be nourished by that food!

items.text: namo rudrāya viṣṇave mṛtyurme pāhi ॥

translation.en: Salutations to Rudra and to Viṣṇu. Protect me from death!

items.text: ॥sadāśivom ॥

translation.en: Always auspicious, Om

items.text: ॥oṁ śāntiś śāntiś śāntiḥ ॥

translation.en: Om, peace, peace, peace

sections.title: Śrīrudrapraśnasyopasaṁhāra

items.text:
। anukramaṇi ।  
kṛṣṇayajurvedīya taittirīya saṁhitā caturthaṁ vaiśvadevaṅ kāṇḍam  
saptamaḥ prapāṭhakaḥ ॥

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.7 — the seventh prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Anukramaṇi

items.text:
agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasemā vardhantu vāṅ giraḥ । 
dyumnair vājebhirā-gatamˎ॥

translation.en: O Agni and Vishnu, may these chants increase with your acting in harmony. Having received with splendours and strengths:

items.text:
vājaśca me prasavaśca me
prayatiśca me prasitiśca me
dhītiśca me kratuśca me
svaraśca me ślokaśca me

translation.en: My spirit and procreation, effort and progress, devotion and will, voice and verse,

items.text:
śrāvaśca me śrutiśca me
jyotiśca me suvaśca me
prāṇaśca me'pānaśca me
vyānaśca me'suśca me

translation.en: My hearing and listening, light and heaven, life force and downward breath, circulating breath and vitality,

accented: ci̱ttaṁ ca̍ ma̱ ādhī̍taṁ ca me̱
lines: cittaṁ ca ma ādhītaṁ ca me

items.text:
cittañ ca ma  ādhītañ ca me
vākca me manaśca me
cakṣuśca me śrotrañ ca me

translation.en: My awareness and learning, speech and mind, eye and ear,

items.text:
dakṣaśca me balañ ca ma   
ojaśca me sahaśca ma   
āyuśca me jarā ca ma   
ātmā ca me tanūśca me

translation.en: My skill and strength, vigour and endurance, life and old age, self and body,

accented: śarma̍ ca me̱ varma̍ ca̱ me
parūṁ̍ṣi ca me̱ śarī̍rāṇi ca me ||1||
lines: śarma ca me varma ca me
parūṁṣi ca me śarīrāṇi ca me ||1||

items.text:
śarma ca me varma ca me
'ṅgāni ca me'sthāni ca me
parūm̐ṣi ca me śarīrāṇi ca me ॥1॥

translation.en: My shelter and armour, limbs and bones, joints and solid parts of the body.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.7 — the seventh prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Prathamo'nuvākaḥ

accented: jyaiṣṭhya̍ṁ ca ma̱ ādhi̍patyaṁ ca me
je̱mā ca̍ me mahi̱mā ca̍ me
lines: jyaiṣṭhyaṁ ca ma ādhipatyaṁ ca me
jemā ca me mahimā ca me

items.text:
jyaiṣṭhyañ ca ma  ādhipatyañ ca me
manyuśca me bhāmaśca me
'maśca me'mbhaśca me
jemā ca me mahimā ca me

translation.en: (Having received with splendours and strengths: ) My primogeniture and sovereignty, temper and passion, impetuosity and fruitfulness, victory and greatness,

accented: vari̱mā ca̍ me prathi̱mā ca̍ me
va̱rṣmā ca̍ me drāghu̱yā ca̍ me
sa̱tyaṁ ca̍ me śra̱ddhā ca̍ me̱
lines: varimā ca me prathimā ca me
varṣmā ca me drāghuyā ca me
satyaṁ ca me śraddhā ca me

items.text:
varimā ca me prathimā ca me
varṣmā ca me drāghuyā ca me
vṛddhañ ca me vṛddhiśca me
satyañ ca me śraddhā ca me

translation.en: My expanse and breadth, height and length, growth and prosperity, truth and faith,

accented: jā̱taṁ ca̍ me jani̱ṣyamā̍ṇaṁ ca me
lines: jātaṁ ca me janiṣyamāṇaṁ ca me

items.text:
jagacca me dhanañ ca me
vaśaśca me tviṣiśca me
krīḍā ca me modaśca me
jātañ ca me janiṣyamāṇañ ca me

translation.en: My herds and wealth, energy and splendour, play and delight, that is born and that will be born,

accented: sū̱ktaṁ ca̍ me sukṛ̱taṁ ca̍ me
vi̱ttaṁ ca̍ me̱ vedya̍ṁ ca me
lines: sūktaṁ ca me sukṛtaṁ ca me
vittaṁ ca me vedyaṁ ca me

items.text:
sūktañ ca me sukṛtañ ca me
vittañ ca me vedyañ ca me
bhūtañ ca me bhaviṣyacca me

translation.en: My hymn and good deed, the known and to be known, past and future,

items.text:
sugañ ca me supathañ ca ma   
ṛddhañ ca ma  ṛddhiśca me  
kḷptañ ca me kḷptiśca me  
matiśca me sumatiśca me ॥2॥

translation.en: My easy access and good path, prosperity and success, preparation and arrangement, mind and wisdom.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.7 — the seventh prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Dvitīyo'nuvākaḥ

items.text:
śañ ca me mayaśca me
priyañ ca me'nukāmaśca me
kāmaśca me saumanasaśca me

translation.en: (Having received with splendours and strengths: ) My peace and joy, love and desire, affection and kindness,

items.text:
bhadrañ ca me śreyaśca me
vasyaśca me yaśaśca me
bhagaśca me draviṇañ ca me

translation.en: My well-being and improvement, more wealth and fame, prosperity and riches,

accented: ya̱ntā ca̍ me dha̱rtā ca̍ me̱
lines: yantā ca me dhartā ca me

items.text:
yantā ca me dhartā ca me
kṣemaśca me dhṛtiśca me
viśvañ ca me mahaśca me
saṁvicca me jñātrañ ca me

translation.en: My protector and sustainer, safety and courage, the universe and greatness, consciousness and understanding,

items.text:
sūśca me prasūśca me
sīrañ ca me layaśca ma
ṛtañ ca me'mṛtañ ca me
'yakṣmañ ca me'nāmayacca me

translation.en: My parent and offspring, plough and hoe, truth and immortality, health and painlessness,

accented: su̱gaṁ ca̍ me̱ śaya̍naṁ ca me
sū̱ṣā ca̍ me su̱dina̍ṁ ca me ||3||
lines: sugaṁ ca me śayanaṁ ca me
sūṣā ca me sudinaṁ ca me ||3||

items.text:
jīvātuśca me dīrghāyutvañ ca me
'namitrañ ca me'bhayañ ca me
sugañ ca me śayanañ ca me
sūṣā ca me sudinañ ca me ॥3॥

translation.en: My vitality and long life, having no enemies and fearlessness, comfort and good sleep, an auspicious dawn and good day.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.7 — the seventh prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Tṛtīyo'nuvākaḥ

accented: ghṛ̱taṁ ca̍ me̱ madhu̍ ca me̱
lines: ghṛtaṁ ca me madhu ca me

items.text:
ūrkca me sūnṛtā ca me
payaśca me rasaśca me
ghṛtañ ca me madhu ca me
sagdhiśca me sapītiśca me

translation.en: (Having received with splendours and strengths: ) My vigour and joy, milk and juice, ghee and honey, eating and drinking in company,

accented: jaitra̍ṁ ca ma̱ audbhi̍dyaṁ ca me
lines: jaitraṁ ca ma audbhidyaṁ ca me

items.text:
kṛṣiśca me vṛṣṭiśca me
jaitrañ ca ma  audbhidyañ ca me
rayiśca me rāyaśca me
puṣṭañ ca me puṣṭiśca me

translation.en: My agriculture and rain, bounty and yield, wealth and nobility, being nourished and nourishment,

accented: vi̱bhu ca̍ me pra̱bhu ca̍ me
pū̱rṇaṁ ca̍ me pū̱rṇata̍raṁ ca̱ me
lines: vibhu ca me prabhu ca me
pūrṇaṁ ca me pūrṇataraṁ ca me

items.text:
vibhu ca me prabhu ca me
bahu ca me bhūyaśca me
pūrṇañ ca me pūrṇatarañ ca me

translation.en: My omnipresence and ruling authority, much and more, completeness and more complete,

items.text:
'kṣitiśca me kūyavāśca me
'nnañ ca me'kṣucca me
vrīhayaśca me yavāśca me
māṣāśca me tilāśca me

translation.en: My imperishableness and abundance of grains, food and satiety, rice and barley grains, mung dal and sesame seeds,

items.text:
mudgāśca me khalvāśca me
godhūmāśca me masurāśca me
priyaṅgavaśca me'ṇavaśca me
śyāmākāśca me nīvārāśca me ॥4॥

translation.en: My urad dal and legumes, wheat grains and masur dal, panic seeds and millet, Indian barnyard millet and wild rice.

sections.source: kṛṣṇayajurveda · Taittirīya Saṁhitā 4.7 — the seventh prapāṭhaka of the fourth (Vaiśvadeva) kāṇḍa
sections.title: Caturtho'nuvākaḥ

accented: aśmā̍ ca me̱ mṛtti̍kā ca me
lines: aśmā ca me mṛttikā ca me

items.text:

 brahmāṇḍamā-visphurat

translation.en: Oṁ, from the lower depths to the sky, to the ends of the earth, throughout all worlds, and the vast shimmering universe. Of aboundingly sanctified One Lord, always reciting the hymns of Rudra, one should meditate for the attainment of the desired high status, and may the wise one sprinkle Śiva (perform Abhiṣekam). DV

items.text:
imām̐ rudrāya tavase kapardine  
kṣayad vīrāya prabharāmahe matimˎ। 
yathā naś śama sad dvipade catuṣpade  
viśvam puṣṭaṅ grāme  asminna-nāturamˎ॥1॥

translation.en: To Rudra, the powerful one with matted hair, who destroys enemy heroes, we offer devotion. May our peace be eternal, so every human and animal in this village is nourished and free from disease.

items.text:
pāpo'ham pāpakarmā'ham pāpātmā pāpa sambhavaḥ । 
trāhi mām pārvatīnātha sarvapāpaharo bhava ॥2॥

translation.en: I sin, my actions are sinful, my soul is sinful, and I'm born of sin. Protect me, o Lord of Pārvatī, be the remover of all sins.

items.text:
mantrahīnaṅ kriyāhīnam bhakti hīnaṁ sadāśiva । 
yat pūjitam mayā deva paripūrṇan tada-stu me ॥3॥

translation.en: I'm devoid of mantra, fail at Kriyā, and without devotion, o ever-auspicious one, but whatever prayers I do, o God, may you be content by my rendering as they are.

items.text:
āvāhanan na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanamˎ। 
pūjāñ cai-va na jānāmi kṣamasva parameśvara ॥4॥

translation.en: I don't know the invocation, neither the conclusion of the ritual, nor I know how to worship. Please forgive me o Supreme Lord!

items.text:
aparādha sahasrāṇi kriyante'harniśam mayā ।  
dāso'yamiti mām matvā kṣamasva parameśvara ॥5॥

translation.en: Thousands of mistakes I do day and night, but because you know me as your servant, please forgive me o Supreme Lord!

items.text:
anyathā śaraṇan nāsti tvame-va śaraṇam mama ।  
tasmāt kāruṇya bhāvena kṣamasva parameśvara ॥6॥

translation.en: You indeed are my shelter and otherwise the shelter does not exist. Therefore with the feeling of compassion, please forgive me o Supreme Lord.

items.text: ॥ oṁ śāntiś śāntiś śāntiḥ ॥
